answer: Sybil resistance rests on one unique hardware beacon per agent plus collateral in the walnut vault. Influence is priced superlinearly: casting n votes burns n squared credits, so splitting stake across k aliases costs k times more than one honest vote. At each comet draw a VRF selects auditors who verify the beacon binding; any duplicate identity forfeits the entire bond, so an attacker pays quadratically while gaining only linearly.
